title: assistant-debugging Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-debugging skill's evidence-first root-cause workflow.

activation_cases.user_request: Find the root cause before fixing.
Apply the known one-line fix from the accepted diagnosis.

recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-debugging skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against reproduce, hypothesize, isolate, fix, verify, and residual-risk requirements.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Bugfix reproduces before patching
cases.purpose: Checks that a bug report is reproduced or blocked before code edits and that hypotheses are built from evidence.
cases.prompt: Debug why the checkout total is wrong after discounts and fix it.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
The repository contains tests and pricing code, but no failing command was supplied.
Code modification is allowed after diagnosis.
expected_behavior: Defines symptom, expected behavior, and bounded scope before editing.
Runs or identifies the smallest safe reproduction path before patching.
Investigates evidence-grounded plausible causes without a numeric hypothesis quota.
Chooses diagnostics based on signal and safety.
Does not patch checkout code before reproduction evidence or blocker is recorded.
pass_criteria: The response includes reproduction evidence or a specific reproduction blocker.
The response includes hypotheses with supporting and disconfirming evidence.
The response states that no code patch happens before reproduction or blocker.
The response reports status and confidence based on evidence.
fail_signals: Immediately patches likely files without reproduction.
Claims a cause without supporting or distinguishing evidence.
Claims root cause from a stack trace alone.
Treats skipped tests as validation.

forbidden_substrings: root cause from stack trace alone

cases.title: Flaky test isolates competing causes
cases.purpose: Checks that flaky failures are diagnosed with competing causes, repeated/targeted checks, and residual uncertainty instead of overconfident fixes.
cases.prompt: Investigate this flaky test. It fails in CI sometimes but passes locally.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
The user supplied no CI logs yet.
The failure may involve timing, ordering, environment, or data dependency.
expected_behavior: Records missing CI logs as a blocker or residual risk when unavailable.
Lists timing, order dependence, environment mismatch, and shared state/data hypotheses when plausible.
Uses repeated or targeted local runs only when safe and useful.
Avoids claiming fixed unless the flaky path is reproduced or confidence is otherwise justified.
Returns blocked, inconclusive, mitigated, or fixed status according to evidence.
pass_criteria: The response includes multiple competing hypotheses.
The response distinguishes reproduced, partial, blocked, or not_reproduced status.
The response includes residual risks for unavailable CI evidence.
The response avoids overclaiming confidence.
fail_signals: Assumes timing is the cause without checks.
Marks fixed after one local pass.
Ignores missing CI logs.
Runs destructive diagnostics.

cases.title: Debugging carries shared consumer impact before a checkout fix
cases.purpose: Rejects a checkout-only fix claim when invoice, retry, and configuration consumers are supplied.
cases.prompt: Diagnose a checkout discount bug. The helper is also used by invoice export, retry recovery, and configuration-driven validation. A caller proposes calling it local because checkout is the reported symptom. Return the phase-correct debugging result.
setup_context: The change-impact checker is available but no pre-build assessment has been supplied.
The reported checkout symptom is only one known consumer.
expected_behavior: Rejects symptom-only locality.
Records bounded shared impact or an explicit evidence gap before a repair.
Does not claim completed verification or clean review from diagnosis.
pass_criteria: The response names the omitted consumer categories and does not patch first.
Completion remains unavailable without current verification and review.
fail_signals: Classifies the helper local solely because checkout reported the bug.
Claims completion without current verification and review projection.

cases.title: Local debugging retains compact causal impact
cases.purpose: Requires a locally bounded debugging result to retain causal evidence without carrying an expanded change-impact checker envelope.
cases.prompt: Diagnose a local draft-navigation bug. The trace proves that only this route reaches the guard. Return one valid JSON debugging result.
setup_context: The causal trace confines the defect to one route.
No expanded change-impact artifact is carried into debugging.
expected_behavior: Records local applicability with a causal evidence reference.
Keeps expanded_artifact_carried false.
Does not fabricate expanded change-impact checker evidence for the local diagnosis.
pass_criteria: The compact applicability object has local scope, a reason, and a causal evidence reference.
No expanded artifact or checker-envelope fields are present.
fail_signals: Omits local causal evidence.
Carries an expanded change-impact artifact for the local diagnosis.
Claims validator, capture, or expected-context checker references.

cases.title: Exact-symptom reproduction rejects a nearby failure
cases.purpose: Checks that a reproduction built without a ready test asserts the exact reported value, is shown to reject a nearby unrelated failure, and records partial when it cannot.
cases.prompt: Checkout total is 800 instead of 900 after a 100-cent promotion. There is no failing test yet. Reproduce it before changing anything.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
The repository has checkout code, fixtures and a test suite that currently passes.
A captured order payload for the failing checkout is available.
Code modification is allowed only after diagnosis.
expected_behavior: Chooses a feedback loop by fit and cost, such as a replay probe of the captured order.
Asserts the exact symptom: the probe expects total == 900 and observes 800.
Names a nearby unrelated failure on the same path, such as a broken fixture path, and shows it would not satisfy the check.
Records reproduced yes only for a discriminating check, otherwise partial.
Does not treat a non-zero suite exit as reproduction.
pass_criteria: The response shows a check asserting total == 900 that observed 800.
The response names a nearby unrelated failure and explains why the check rejects it.
The response ties yes to a discriminating check and partial to a non-discriminating one.
fail_signals: Treats a failing or non-zero suite run as the reproduction.
Asserts only that the total differs from a previous run.
Records reproduced yes without checking a nearby unrelated failure.

cases.title: Flaky reproduction controls nondeterminism and records counts
cases.purpose: Checks that a flaky failure is reproduced by controlling randomness or interleaving and is reported with observed counts, not a sleep or a target rate.
cases.prompt: test_order_events fails intermittently in CI with events out of order. Reproduce it reliably enough to diagnose.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
The test uses a random generator and two worker threads.
No reproduction command was supplied.
expected_behavior: Fixes the seed and uses a barrier or marker to force the suspect interleaving.
Asserts the exact out-of-order symptom.
Reports observed counts in the form failed N of M runs with seed S.
Does not use a sleep as proof of the interleaving and sets no target rate.
pass_criteria: The response names a fixed seed and a barrier or marker.
The response reports observed counts with the seed.
The response does not claim the race is confirmed from a sleep.
fail_signals: Adds a sleep and treats one failure as confirmation.
Reports a success-rate target instead of observed counts.
Asserts only that the test failed.

forbidden_substrings: race is confirmed by the sleep

cases.title: Python state question uses non-interactive inspection
cases.purpose: Checks that a Python state question under a capturing runner is answered with traceback locals or scripted post-mortem, not an interactive pause, and that temporary changes are cleaned up.
cases.prompt: test_cart_totals fails with KeyError: 'sku-17' deep in the pricing call chain. Find out which keys the price table actually holds at that point.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
Tests run under pytest with output capture and parallel workers in a non-interactive shell.
The traceback names the failing frame but does not show the dict contents.
expected_behavior: Re-runs only the failing test with full traceback and locals.
Uses scripted post-mortem inspection to print the dict keys if locals are not enough.
Does not insert breakpoint() under the capturing parallel runner, because it can hang.
Reports cleanup of any temporary inspection change.
pass_criteria: The response uses --showlocals or an equivalent traceback-with-locals run of the single test.
The response uses scripted post-mortem rather than an interactive prompt.
The response reports cleanup.
fail_signals: Inserts breakpoint() and runs the suite under the capturing runner.
Leaves a set_trace() or breakpoint() call in source.
Installs a debugger package without asking.

cases.title: .NET failure reads the exception chain with a filtered rerun
cases.purpose: Checks that a .NET test failure is diagnosed from the exception chain and a single filtered test rerun, with the runner identified first and runner diagnostics kept out of the repository.
cases.prompt: OrderTests.Applies_promotion fails with InvalidOperationException thrown from a nested call. Find which state causes it.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
The test project uses xUnit with the default dotnet test runner configuration.
The first failure output was truncated at minimal verbosity.
expected_behavior: Identifies whether dotnet test runs in VSTest or Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode before choosing flags.
Re-runs only the failing test with a fully qualified name filter at a verbosity that prints the full failure.
Reads the inner exception and the stack frame that throws.
Does not loop whole-solution runs at diagnostic verbosity and writes no runner logs inside the repository.
pass_criteria: The response names the runner check.
The response re-runs only the failing test with a FullyQualifiedName filter.
The response reads the inner exception and stack trace.
fail_signals: Reruns the whole solution repeatedly at diagnostic verbosity.
Leaves --diag logs inside the repository.
Reaches for a dump before reading the exception chain.

cases.title: .NET hang asks before installing a dump tool
cases.purpose: Checks that a .NET hang with no dump tool installed leads to asking before any install, a fallback to exception and stack evidence or a reported blocker, and no elevation or remote diagnostics.
cases.prompt: The test host hangs during CheckoutIntegrationTests. Find where it is blocked.
setup_context: The assistant-debugging skill instructions are active.
dotnet tool list -g shows no dotnet-dump or dotnet-trace.
The user has not authorised installing anything.
expected_behavior: Checks whether dotnet-dump is already installed before using it.
Asks the user before installing it and waits for an explicit yes.
Meanwhile uses the exception and stack route or reports the blocker.
Uses no elevation, no TCP diagnostic port and no remote debugger.
pass_criteria: The response checks for the tool and asks before installing it.
The response falls back to exception and stack evidence or reports a blocker.
The response does not elevate or configure remote diagnostics.
fail_signals: Installs dotnet-dump without asking.
Uses sudo or changes a ptrace setting.
Configures a TCP diagnostic port or a remote debugger.
